title.en: New article: Auditing the Hidden Costs of Terminal AI Assistants

body.id: Satu tulisan baru ditambahkan ke blog: "Membedah Biaya Token AI yang Sering Bikin Dompet Kaget". Tulisannya membahas catatan santai tentang alat audit konsumsi token seperti tokendoctor dan cara cerdas menghemat biaya asisten kecerdasan buatan harian
body.en: A new article was added to the blog: "Auditing the Hidden Costs of Terminal AI Assistants". It covers a grounded reflection on token audit tools like tokendoctor and practical ways to prevent bloated bills from command line coding models
